sources: The roll call records the United Kingdom voting for resolution 2757 (2024), renewing EUFOR-Althea. The Council President then spoke in the United Kingdom's national capacity. The United Kingdom welcomed the EUFOR renewal and maintained that the High Representative continued to play a vital role in upholding the Dayton Peace Agreement.

The roll call records Russia voting for resolution 2757 (2024), renewing EUFOR-Althea. In its national statement Russia called for closing the Office of the High Representative as soon as possible, argued that the Office had exhausted its functions, and urged strengthening the Dayton framework.
proposals: The United Kingdom and Russia both voted to renew EUFOR-Althea.

sources: China welcomed the Council's unanimous adoption of resolution 2777 (2025), extending UNAMA for one year. China said it initiated consultations in February and worked with Denmark in March to advance consultations. China supported UNAMA's continued role connecting international actors with Afghanistan.

Pakistan voted for resolution 2777 (2025), extending UNAMA for one year. Pakistan said that China and Pakistan circulated the initial draft together and welcomed Denmark's facilitation as Council President. Pakistan committed to continued cooperation with UNAMA.
proposals: China and Pakistan both supported a one-year UNAMA mandate renewal.
